eligible.content: For sure—I’m tracking it in a notebook for now, nothing fancy. The roots seem happier already, less mushy. If this keeps up, I might try splitting one of the plants next week to test propagation in the sand mix. Worst case, I lose a cutting and learn something. Either way, progress. I’ll shout either way how it goes.

Appreciate that—yeah, I’ll know by midweek if the cuttings take. Gotta watch the humidity though; last time I lost a batch ’cause the plastic cover cracked. Anyway, if this batch works, I’m thinking of trying a mix with perlite next. Let’s see how far we can push it with what we’ve got.

Thanks—yeah, I put the perlite mix together yesterday, and the texture’s way better. Drains fast but still holds a bit of moisture. Two cuttings are already showing tiny roots after just four days, which is way quicker than last time. Might’ve cracked the code, or I just got lucky. Either way, I’ll pot one up this weekend and see how it handles real soil. Fingers crossed.
That’s excellent news on the root development—seeing results that quickly is a great sign! Good luck with the potting this weekend; I'd love to hear how the soil holds up against the new mix!
